_comment: Unichain Sepolia (1301) currencies to wire into ChainlinkPriceOracle via SetOracleFeeds.s.sol. Parallel arrays; `symbol` keys into script/oracle_feeds.json, `decimals` is the token's own ERC-20 decimals (18 for native ETH = address(0)). Every address below was verified on-chain (symbol + decimals) on 2026-09-08. Two entries may share one `symbol` — native ETH and WETH both price off ETH/USD. Testnet. The chain has BTC/ETH/USDC/USDT/LINK feeds, but only these four currencies exist as real tokens on it — there is no canonical WBTC or USDT on Unichain Sepolia, so those two feeds stay unwired. USDC is Circle's testnet token, LINK is Chainlink's faucet token. Wrapped/bridged representations ride the base asset's feed: a depeg of the wrapper itself is outside what the oracle can see. That is the same trade-off already taken for WBTC on chains with no WBTC/USD feed.
